title: 四象限字形系统｜触点启动、分栏接力与手机锁定
source_title: 动态图形宣言｜四格图标和大字逐章组成移动设计系统
summary: 固定黑、奶油、薄荷、橙红四色与四象限网格，手指触点启动图标和字块；分栏、推移、旋转与唱片式圆环逐步合并，最终在手机框中锁定完整原创短句。
input_format: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins. + Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier. + Give each secondary word one distinct readable physical action inside the inherited structure. + Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling. + Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.
recommended_input: 建立奶油色四格网格，包含手指图标、圆点轨道、折叠盒和字母碎片。；在两个分栏中组装准确原创词【SHAPE】和【MOVE】，圆点与盒子保持同一节拍。；拉远到简洁手机框，停留准确原创短句【FIFTEEN SECONDS, MANY DIRECTIONS】。
required_anchors: A single accent dot initiates the sequence.
Letter assembly remains legible before collapse.
The final lockup contains only original copy and preserves the earlier geometry.
